newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady despite berth congestion.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady despite berth congestion.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers maintained recent offers on Monday despite ongoing berth congestion, traders said.
Demand was as usual slack on Mondays, they said. "Although the berth congestion caused some problems in lifting supplies, demand is poor that we cannot raise offers," said one supplier.
Bunker 380-cst were quoted at $97/$98 by majors.
MDO and gas oil were quoted at $170/$175 and $180/$183 per tonne respectively.
